description: Multi-engine desktop translation tool (QuestSoft). Translates selected text via Google/Bing/Yandex/etc., with hotkey-based popup, dictionary, and TTS.
notes: QTranslate's NSIS installer requires elevation and installs to %ProgramFiles(x86)%\QTranslate (32-bit installer).
This manifest runs the installer silently with a UAC prompt, then leaves scoop's app dir empty -- scoop tracks the install record only.
Use the Start menu shortcut created by the NSIS installer to launch (scoop does not shim the exe because the binary lives outside scoop's reach).
'Start with Windows' (in QTranslate's Options) is available because the installer enters 'installed' mode (no Data\ next to the exe).

script: Write-Host 'Running QTranslate installer (will prompt for elevation)...'
if ($proc.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "QTranslate installer exited with code $($proc.ExitCode)" }
Write-Host "Running QTranslate uninstaller (will prompt for elevation): $uninst"
Write-Host 'No QTranslate uninstaller found in Program Files / Program Files (x86) -- nothing to remove.'
